checks.message: Provisional boundary is present; replace with official redline before professional scoring.
Three required key areas are provisional; replace with official polygons before professional scoring.
Initial land-use polygons are derived from site boundary partitioning.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.

v3.0 concept prioritizes human rights and universal access, uses H0-H3 graded access, five scenarios by five friendliness dimensions, human fallback, auditable governance, and unknown-baseline disclosure.

Spine RD-001 rebuilt as an 82-vertex curve (9664.9 m), lies fully inside the green corridor and the site, and intersects all three key areas; RD-014/015 are genuinely closed loops inside their key areas; no road leaves the site boundary.

10 of 12 scenario nodes now sit inside their assigned key area; SN-005 and SN-009 are explicitly declared corridor-segment nodes with key_area_id=null. Every node carries within_key_area, distance_to_spine_m and location_uncertainty_m.

Figure 06 renders the submitted GeoJSON directly with scale bar, north arrow, four-level precision grades (A recomputable / B structurally credible / C schematic +-200m / D unavailable) and the six mandatory P0 field-survey items.

Road length updated to 41539.676 m and node density recomputed against the spine; green ratio, public space ratio, building footprint and land-use coverage are unchanged because no area layer geometry moved.

The five generative concept figures were corrected rather than discarded: the unsupported 20km/h claim is removed, corridor extents are restated as 9.7km x 1.4km, the G1-G3 right-of-way set is replaced by H0-H3, the fabricated 3.0m machine-lane width is withdrawn, and the KPI radars no longer draw filled polygons that would imply a measured baseline.

Proposal declares two coexisting figure sets, names the generative model used for the concept figures, grades them as C schematic, and states that the deterministic technical figures and machine-readable data prevail on any conflict.
Figures now quote road length 41.5 km, spine 9.665 km / 82 vertices, 12 scenario nodes at 1.24 per km, 10/12 key-area containment and FAR unknown, matching metrics.json.
Added a dedicated brand identity board for 人机友好京张 with mark construction, bilingual naming, application surfaces, palette and allow/deny use rules.
Added an agent.6 international outreach battle map with Q1-Q4 cadence, see-arrive-join-deposit funnel, reusable assets and non-commitment boundaries.
Added an explicit differentiation board against crowded Commons and Chevron-line narratives, anchoring this package on enforceable H0-H3 shared-spine rules and evidence honesty.
